reviewSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody held at 868930d6… and mode 0444 across the whole review. All 11 digest assertions in the draft recomputed from disk without mismatch, and independently all 42 recordedInputs pins in the frozen successor reproduced, so the subject's own remeasurement precondition holds. Both Stage A return shapes were strict-parsed rather than taken from the dispatch paraphrase: Claude ACCEPT with two observationsNotFindings objects carrying location, observation and whyItIsNotAFinding and no id, and Codex ACCEPT with an empty observationsNotFindings list; neither carries a decision, observations, findings or blockers field, and the draft recites both correctly without flattening either to a string or minting an id. The four honesty identifiers the dispatch requires to be named — v8 ADV-1, OBS-1, OBS-2 and v7 ADV-1, ADV-2, ADV-3 — are all source-assigned and all named. The v7 and v8 Codex unlabeled SHOULD-FIX landings were verified in bytes at v8 and v9 respectively rather than accepted on assertion. Authority boundary is clean: no row SATISFIED, no Class A opened, live DR-117/DR-125/DR-131/DR-133/DR-G20 all OPEN, DR-118 and DR-107 tokens unflattened, required-now 28, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 MET at 28 of 28, file 08 and COORD byte-identical to the dispatch digests and unmodified in the working tree. leftover-design of OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED remains, leftover-design of OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING is narrowed only on DR-125 and is preserved on g20 leftover-join.v11 / DR-G20, g20 leftover-join.v11 and occupancy v2 are unmoved, sdk leftover-join.v7 and v8 stay unrecorded, and v6's currency is bounded by 'until this successor is recorded'. No deixis, no unstemmed version token, no predecessor voicing, no invented identifier, and no D-319 heading claim. All 13 dispatch attacks and 12 additional independent attacks were refuted; four observations travel as honesty work with no change requested.
